description: Event handlers that record interrupted turns and compaction failures to disk for recovery.

steps.description: Turn_end handler: triggers on length, error, or aborted stopReason.
Condition: checks if stopReason is in the failure set.
Record: calls record function with stopReason context.
Notification: warns user to check disk state before retrying.
Session_compact_failed handler: records compaction failure with reason.

title: pi Event Handlers for Interruption
